Both read paths go through the page cache and run synchronously before the forward:  - #59958 does `WILLNEED` + one `preadv` per row from Python, with a stream sync before staging. - #62238 gathers rows through an mmap. candidates.title: [Performance][KV Cache][Kimi-K3.1-Pro] DCP8 wastes shared-pool capacity on replicated draft KV
candidates.snippet: ## Summary  On Kimi-K3.1-Pro with a replicated DSpark draft under DCP8, a draft page contains **5 MiB** but reserves a **22.6875 MiB** shared-pool block. Target KV is still sharded; the replicated draft limits the capacity gain.  This adds a concrete TP8/DCP8 case to the existing hybrid-grouping discussion in #58638.
